impact: http.ts: const ZUG_TOKEN = process.env.ZUG_TOKEN || ''. timingSafeEqual against empty string means no raw-token client can authenticate unless the env var is explicitly set. Deploy docs don't call this out clearly enough.
resolution: http.ts now emits a startup warning when ZUG_TOKEN is not set: '[zug] Warning: ZUG_TOKEN is not set — server accepts connections without a shared secret'. README updated to note the warning behavior.
title: ZUG_TOKEN defaults to empty string — X-Zug-Token auth path silently broken if env var unset
